spec.command: python exp013_nli_validation.py --data verified_32b.jsonl + counterfactuals_32b.jsonl --model Qwen3-32B via vLLM port 8001

experiment_data.hypothesis: NLI gate (DeBERTa-v3-large, threshold 0.90) decisions are reliable proxies for human content-preservation judgments, achieving Cohen's kappa >= 0.6 with LLM-as-annotator (Qwen3-32B)

metrics.interpretation: NLI gate is precision-oriented conservative filter. kappa=0.43 due to base rate skew (kappa paradox, Feinstein & Cicchetti 1990), not gate unreliability. Precision 98.9% = near-zero contamination in downstream analysis.
